obligations.statement: For any reachable sequence of faithful steps over a rational measure, zero weighted delta at every step preserves that measure.
assumptions: Each step realizes its declared weighted delta.
Every step has zero weighted delta.

obligations.statement: Two abstract one-step query maintainers satisfying their local Correct equations compose into a one-step maintainer for the composed query.
assumptions: Each local operator satisfies its abstract Correct equation under the supplied state addition functions.

obligations.statement: Conjunctive extensions with no new projected writers preserve base safety invariants.
assumptions: Extension initial states project to admitted base initial states.
Every extension step projects to a base step.
Base initialization and each base step preserve the invariant.

obligations.statement: For every i64 n, production Rational::checked_neg on (n, 1) returns None exactly when mathematical -n exceeds i64::MAX, otherwise exactly (-n, 1).
assumptions: Input is a canonical integer rational with denominator 1.
Kani 0.67.0, its Rust compiler and CBMC faithfully implement fixed-width Rust semantics; unwinding assertions are enabled.
